ldraw.title: Minifig Torso with Blue V-Neck, Pockets and 3 Buttons Pattern

externalAliases.title: Torso Vest with Pockets and Buttons over Blue Shirt Pattern

review.rationale: LDraw 973p06 and BrickLink 973pb0069 independently describe the same torso print identity: a blue V-neck/shirt beneath a vest with pockets and buttons. This resolves the decorated-part identity only; it does not establish an official LEGO Design ID or Element ID.
